candidate: RevealedLoadout: weighted mode among same-species sets consistent with revealed moves and original item; original fallback when none match
opponent_fixtures: opponents.json: 8 explicit legal scenarios, 2 historically observed preview cores x 4 Perish-trap kits; not exact historical team reconstructions

stress.opponent: blind bot with a fixed public-information trap/Perish/stall/escape script and forced Misdreavus lead

natural.opponent: unmodified blind bot, free selection and play on same off-pool teams

onpool_control.opponent: unmodified blind bot on current 24-team catalog

cap_handling: report separately; conventional 0.5 score plus worst/best-case difference interval
primary_endpoint: paired terminal outcome score difference on stress test, with 95% stratified bootstrap interval
promotion_requirement: positive outcome evidence and no unresolved ordinary-play regression; action changes and belief coverage alone do not qualify
limitations: Scripted opponent is a stress test, not a human population estimate
32 natural pairs cannot establish a tight noninferiority margin
Conditioned mode does not add uncertainty before the first reveal
effect_attribution: Policy conditions all fallback species, so any outcome gain cannot be attributed solely to Misdreavus/Perish Song.
